title: Stub Accrual for Days No Statement Has Recorded: Crestline Credit Card Deferred Interest
content:
When Northgate assesses deferred interest on a Crestline Credit Card promotional plan, the stub accrual covers the days no statement has recorded yet: when the period ended after the closing date of the plan's last recorded accrual, interest on the recorded balance at the daily rate for each stub day is added; when the period ended on that closing date, nothing is added; when no accrual has been recorded for the plan, interest on the recorded balance for each day from the purchase date through the last day of the period is added. The stub accrual is added to the deferred interest assessed.

- **Recorded balance:** the plan's purchase amount less the payment allocations recorded for it and less the merchandise credits that carry its ticket number.
- **Daily rate:** the account's purchase rate divided by 365 (the product's daily rate basis in days).
- **Stub days:** the days from the day after the closing date of the plan's last recorded accrual through the last day of its period (its expiration date).

## Decision table

| Plan's accrual record | Last day of the period | Stub accrual added |
|---|---|---|
| accruals recorded | after the last accrual's closing date | recorded balance multiplied by the daily rate, multiplied by the stub days |
| accruals recorded | on the last accrual's closing date | nothing |
| no accrual recorded | — | recorded balance multiplied by the daily rate, multiplied by the days from the purchase date through the last day of the period, both counted |

## Cases (hypothetical)

Hypothetical figures use a purchase rate of 36.5 percent, so that the daily rate is a round 0.1 percent.

- Last accrual closing 10 June, period's last day 14 June, recorded balance 600.00 USD: stub days are 11 to 14 June, 4 days; 600.00 multiplied by 0.001 multiplied by 4 is 2.40 USD.
- Last accrual closing 14 June, period's last day 14 June: nothing.
- No accrual recorded, purchase 1 May, period's last day 30 May, recorded balance 250.00 USD: 30 days; 7.50 USD.
